items.title: ZDI-CAN-34401: Apple
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-09-17, 1 days ago. The vendor is given until 2027-01-15 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
